'''Capitoline Hill''' is an area located in {{Location|Septimont|nocat=1}} and where the [[Capitoline Hill City|capital city]] of the region is located.

== NPCs ==
{{NPCs by Location List|Capitoline Hill}} 

==Trivia==
* '''Capitoline Hill''' (''Mons Capitolinus; Campidoglio'') or '''Capitolium''' is one of the {{w|Seven Hills of Rome}}, earlier known as ''Mons Saturnius'' and dedicated to Roman god {{w|Saturn (mythology)|Saturn}}.
=== Etymology ===
* "''Capitoline''" is a precursor to the English word ''capitol'' and borrowed from the Latin word ''capitulum''.
** ''Capitulum'' is formed from the Latin word ''caput'' ("head") and the diminutive suffix ''-ulum''.
